issues.title: Missile lists don't show headers properly
issues.body:
We're using a JS snippet to convert headers (entries beginning with '###) into opt-groups, so they are not selectable.

The demo is here, but see the example below: https://pmk65.github.io/jedemov2/dist/demo.html

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/222196895-9c6f3201-117f-4979-b378-90681019a54a.png)

But, we don't transform the data.  The code to do it is in `json-editor/index.tsx`

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/222196549-2cc6155b-c13f-4bf1-8ce8-859042150be8.png)

My _guess_ is that we do the JS trick when the form loads, but when we're starting with a blank form, the list of own assets is empty, so there is no select control to transform.

Maybe we need to intercept the "row-add" event, somehow.

Aah, yes - the above is right.  When we `Edit` an existing "Strike" document, the select control is already generated, and gets transformed as below:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/222199083-3eb7bfe9-5236-4171-bf8a-93e7eb0550a5.png)

Aah, but if we added new rows in the `Edit` form, they would not get adapted.
